name: mikrotik-routeros
description: The RouterOS plugin — device inventory, health, DHCP, firewall, and VPN capabilities — connects to live MikroTik routers via the RouterOS REST API. Plain English explanations for noobs, full RouterOS API access for professionals, deep Bastion integration, and NOC/SOC-grade monitoring.
shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS management — connects to live routers.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Plain English explanations for networking noobs
Full RouterOS API access for professionals
Safe firewall management with address lists

discovery.name: Router Discovery
discovery.description: Automatically discover MikroTik routers on your network using neighbor discovery protocols. Build a complete inventory of all devices.

monitoring.name: Health Monitoring
monitoring.description: Real-time monitoring of CPU, memory, temperature, and interface status. Get health scores and instant alerts when issues arise.

dhcpManagement.name: DHCP Management
dhcpManagement.description: View and manage DHCP leases, create static reservations, detect IP conflicts, and monitor pool utilization with MAC vendor lookup.

firewallRules.name: Firewall Management
firewallRules.description: View firewall rules, block/unblock IPs using address lists, and see rule hit counters. All with safety controls to prevent mistakes.

vpnHealth.name: VPN Monitoring
vpnHealth.description: Monitor WireGuard peers and IPsec tunnels. Track handshake freshness, traffic stats, and get alerts for stale connections.

diagnostics.name: Troubleshooting
diagnostics.description: AI-powered issue analysis with guided troubleshooting wizard. Ping, traceroute, DNS check, and MTU discovery from your router.

plainEnglish.name: Plain English Mode
plainEnglish.description: Every technical issue explained in plain English using analogies like house addresses and parking lots. Perfect for non-technical users.

automation.name: Safe Automation
automation.description: Auto-remediation for common issues with preview, approval, and automatic rollback. Never make changes you can't undo.

specialist.name: NETWATCH
specialist.description: Your patient networking mentor who adapts to your skill level

requirements.external: MikroTik RouterOS device with API access enabled

routerUnreachable.name: Router Unreachable
routerUnreachable.description: Router has not responded to health checks

ipConflict.description: Two devices are using the same IP address

dhcpPoolExhausted.name: DHCP Pool Near Exhaustion
dhcpPoolExhausted.description: DHCP pool is more than 90% utilized

newDevice.description: Previously unknown device joined the network
